detail: AC6 pins the bot drop as a 'fake-advance (303 to the next question, nothing persisted)'. The bare-URL redirect renders the landing for empty drafts — distinguishable from the legit ?q= advance, leaking the drop to bots.
recommended_fix: Redirect bot-classified answer POSTs to the next unanswered question (?q=<next>#q-<next>), matching the legit advance, so the bot-visible response shape is identical.

title: Validation-error re-render discards the submitted answer — the /apply view_form_with_errors precedent preserves the user's input
detail: Spec: 'Inline re-render (the /apply view_form_with_errors precedent)'. /apply re-renders with submitted values; here the pre-save draft re-fills the form, so a failed answer (over-length text, bad month) is wiped and the referee must retype it.
recommended_fix: Re-render with the failed question's submitted values (falling back to the draft) instead of the pre-save draft, mirroring view_form_with_errors.
